info.name: GuestBook API
info.description:
GuestBook REST API Collection

This collection contains all CRUD operations and the search endpoint for the GuestBook FastAPI backend.

Endpoints Included:
- Get All Reviews
- Get Review By ID
- Search Reviews
- Create Review
- Update Review
- Delete Review
